pieces.Text: As a standard action, you can expend 1 point of mental focus to disrupt the mind of one living creature within 30 feet. The creature can attempt a Will saving throw to negate the effect. If it fails the save, the creature can't concentrate on any spell effects and must succeed at a concentration check to cast any spell (DC = 15 + double the spell level). The affected creature takes a -4 penalty on this check if the spell includes a thought component. The creature takes a -2 penalty on all Will saving throws while under this effect.
